rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not simple or straightforward.

example.english: This math problem is really complex.
example.traditional: 呢條數學題真係好複雜。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 fuk1 zaap6

rows.note: Use this for something made up of many detailed or interlocking parts, especially when it feels elaborate or cumbersome.

example.english: The procedures in this report are quite complex.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅程序相當繁複。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 cing4 zeoi6 soeng1 dong1 faan4 fuk1
